steps: Turn off power to the HVAC system at the breaker.
Take a photo of existing wire terminals, then label each wire.
Remove the old thermostat base and mount the new base plate.
Connect wires to matching terminals (check for a C-wire; use an adapter kit if missing).
Restore power, attach the thermostat, and follow the app setup.
videoTitle: How to Install a Smart Thermostat - This Old House
